About.heroIssue: Est. 03.03.2011 · Ho Chi Minh City · Vietnam
About.storyP1: On March 3rd, 2011, BNI Master Chapter was born — one of the first three chapters of BNI Vietnam. From that founding morning, Master has grown into one of the country's most respected business communities, built on a culture of kindness, integrity and professional ethics.
About.storyP2: Week after week, our members meet, pass referrals and grow each other's businesses through genuine relationships — proving that sustainable business begins with generous people.
About.pullQuote: “Master” means every member is a true expert in their field — and a chapter whose reputation stands among the finest in BNI Vietnam and BNI worldwide.
About.missionText: To help our members grow their businesses through close relationships, positive energy and a relentless focus on results.
About.value1Desc: Every member proactively shares and contributes to one another — with sincerity, integrity and positivity.
About.value2Desc: Every member brings their positive energy to every meeting, and receives that same energy back from everyone in the room.
About.value3Desc: Every member achieves real, tangible results — setting concrete goals, building action strategies and following through until they are reached.
About.powerTitle: The rhythm of a Master member
About.powerSubtitle: The weekly commitments every member makes — honestly and consistently.
About.visionText: By 2031, BNI Master Diamond Chapter will stand among the TOP 3 largest chapters in BNI Vietnam — powered by a community of high-quality members.
About.cultureText: The defining culture of BNI Master is tình thân — a family-like closeness built on kindness, integrity and professional ethics. We believe sustainable business begins with good people.
About.standardIntro: Membership is selective by design. We look for:
About.std1: Directors with equity, or business owners
About.std4: One profession — one single representative in the chapter
About.ctaTitle: Meet us on a Wednesday morning
About.ctaText: The best way to understand Master is to feel the energy of the room. Come as our guest.
